title: Sarfatti's Navy friend and the living craft on the East Coast
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Sarfatti's Navy friend and the living craft on the East Coast, about present at Off the US East Coast (Roosevelt, 2014 to 2015), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they couldn't breach the craft. They couldn't get inside the craft because the craft works. It's alive. It's conscious and it's got an attitude that unless you vibrate at the right level, you can't get in the craft.

plain: A researcher named Grant Cameron tells Jesse Michels a story he says came from Jack Sarfatti, about a friend of Sarfatti's in the US Navy on the East Coast. According to the story, the Navy could not break into a craft it held, because the craft is alive, conscious, and has an attitude: unless you vibrate at the right level, you cannot get in. If true, it would mean some recovered craft are living things rather than machines.
